resources.string: jan %s o, o toki e ni: lipu jan sin ni li lipu sina
sina kama lon lipu LiXiangQi la pona a!

emailConfirm_click
Part of the confirmation email upon registering for a LiXiangQi account.
The unique reset link is presented just after this string.

resources.string: sina wile jo e nimi sina pi lipu LiXiangQi la o luka e nimi ni:
sina kama ala lon lipu LiXiangQi la lipu ni li suli ala tawa sina. lipu sin sina pi ilo ni en sona ale mi pi poki lipu sina li weka tan mi lon pini pi tenpo suno tu kama.
jan %s o, o sin e nimi awen sina pi lipu lixiangqi.com
mi mute li kute e ni: sina wile sin e nimi awen pi lipu sina.
sina toki e ni la o luka e nimi nasin lon anpa. sina toki ala e ni la o weka sona e lipu ni.
jan %s o, toki e nimi sina sin pi lipu toki
sina toki e ni: sina wile ante e nimi sina pi lipu toki.
mi mute wile sona e ni: nimi ni pi lipu toki li nimi sina. tan ni la o luka e nimi nasin:
jan %s o, kama pona tawa lipu lixiangqi.com
jan %s o, o lon e lipu sina lon lipu lixiangqi.com
(sina ken ala luka la o pana e nimi nasin tawa ilo sina!)
sitelen ni li tawa ni: kepeken sina pi lipu %s.
sina wile toki tawa mi mute la, o kepeken %s.
lipu jan sina pi ilo LiXiangQi li lon. sina kama sona e nasin musi anu sina kama sin tawa musi la mi pilin pona tan sina.
o musi Xiangqi
o open e musi lon lipu open. sina wile musi pi pilin lape la o musi lon poka ilo.
o alasa e nasin pona
o kama sona e ni: nasin seme li awen e sina li anpa e jan ante? o pali kepeken tenpo. o lukin e pali sina e pali kama pi jan ante.
o toki e sina
o pana e toki lili pi sina tawa lipu jan sina. ni la jan ante li ken sona e sina.
o lukin e lipu jan sina
o ante e lipu jan sina
o musi pona! mi wile lukin e sina lon musi.
